subject: Primary-source reviewed CIK/CUSIP/security-class transitions without overwriting past identity versions

investigation.existing_loader: load_verified_securities validates individual dated rows and duplicate ticker/CUSIP/interval tuples; it does not validate cross-row identity transitions.
investigation.previous_bulk_gap: Non-overlapping CIK/CUSIP/class changes were accepted with only the ordinary review and next-version identity proofs; there was no hash-bound prior version or primary corporate-action passage.
investigation.scope: The new checks are in preparation/export; the runtime loader and production scoring are unchanged.

implementation: Preflight all baseline and proposed intervals by normalized canonical ticker and CUSIP; reject incompatible issuer/CUSIP/class overlap and duplicate overlap.
Require archived primary issuer SEC HTML for each changed temporal boundary involving a new reviewed row, independent of batch ordering.
Bind exact prior and next registry versions with SHA-256 of the 11 production identity fields, including original known_at, intervals and citation URLs.
Require bounded primary passages quoting both exact ticker/CIK/CUSIP/class identities and an effective date in the preserved interval gap.
Reject unarchived, hidden, script-only, swapped, unrelated, duplicate, backdated or date-conflicting transition claims.
Require both changed boundaries when inserting a newly reviewed version between two existing identities.
Load corporate-action snapshots through the same bounded archive and SEC capture client; require publication time before network access.
Keep all baseline rows intact in the proposal; record baseline bytes SHA-256 and reject a concurrent baseline change before writing outputs.

acceptance_limits: Exact quote matching proves source presence; a named reviewer still verifies old/new roles, legal effect and whether an announced change took effect.
The primary excerpt must explicitly quote old and new ticker/CIK/CUSIP/class and its date; incomplete or unsupported filings stay unresolved.
Current SEC catalog and independent exact Schedule 13 and same-context ticker/class evidence remain required for each proposed row; retired ticker/catalog mismatches are not accepted by this path.
This work does not retroactively certify transition evidence for unrelated historical version pairs already present in a baseline; it rejects their overlaps and validates every new changed boundary.
The individual runtime loader remains unchanged; directly editing production files outside reviewed bulk export bypasses these new review guards.
No live source, relevant coverage, user Windows, or historical acceptance evidence was created; specialist DONE remains unsupported.

The earlier missing-dependency import was resolved using the coordinator-prepared isolated interpreter; the exact 687 regression passed with synthetic cached data and provides no new live identity coverage.
